spec_match.rationale: Probes the two independent halves (constructor overload, serialization) plus legacy compatibility without UA sniffing.

interactive.rationale: Re-run probes, create through the shim, clone and compare, nested cause clone — each runs live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb promises exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Shim reports dropped source/clamped code; nested Error.cause clone shows one non-serializable cause breaking the whole message.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5158277221580800 and the relevant WebTransport spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite has 9 assertions; on Chrome 153 2 pass (interface + default constructor) and 7 fail, so every behavioural assertion can fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 headless: probes no/no/yes; shim downgraded session→stream and 1000→255; clone used plain-record fallback; nested clone threw DataCloneError. Console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the shim path equals the standard probe and the clone type equals the serialization probe.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; amber is used for borders only (never text) because it misses 4.5:1 on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Probe results in a polite list, labelled inputs, focusable code blocks, polite verdicts.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: zero horizontal overflow, no control under 44px, every input labelled.

openQuestions.title: Capture the success path on Chrome 159+
openQuestions.detail: Only Chrome for Testing 153 was available in the container: every page was verified on the legacy-only / non-serializable branch. Re-run on Chrome 159 (or Canary) and confirm the native branch, the green verdicts and the matching telemetry asserts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment (project rule 7b); verification used headless Chrome via Playwright plus screenshots, and label/tap-target checks via DOM queries. Accessibility tree not inspected.

guidanceConsulted.query: web worker postMessage structured clone errors
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use structuredClone/postMessage for platform types; expect DataCloneError for non-serializable values and do not rely on JSON round-trips.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Clone paths call structuredClone/postMessage directly and catch only DataCloneError for the labelled plain-record fallback; no JSON.stringify round-trip.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status output for button results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels, visible focus and a polite status region for results that change after an action.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result verdict is a role=status aria-live=polite paragraph; all inputs/selects have <label for>; :focus-visible outline in accent-blue; buttons are native and >=44px tall.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Intrinsic grid with minmax(min(100%, X), 1fr) so cards/fields wrap without overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Form grids and result cards use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 12-15rem), 1fr)); long values use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

summary: Feature-detect + shim + clone fallback; Chrome 153 exercises every fallback branch.
